claims.evidence: The photos show a Brother computerized sewing/embroidery-style machine with a blue screen, but the SE630 model number is not readable on the machine label in the provided photos.

risks.risk: Model mismatch (could be a different Brother computerized/embroidery model with a similar look).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the machine’s model label/plate (usually on the side/back/bottom) showing “SE630”.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic Brother computerized sewing/embroidery machine (worst-case for value vs SE630).

risks.risk: Not fully functional (screen works but sewing/embroidery may not run correctly; motor timing, stitch accuracy, or embroidery unit issues).
risks.proof: A short video of it stitching a straight line and a short programmed embroidery stitch-out (with the bobbin installed).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/consumables (foot pedal, power cable, bobbins, needles, embroidery hoops/frames, USB/cord, manual).
risks.proof: A photo laid out showing every included accessory + a photo of the underside/battery/port area if applicable.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as machine only (worst-case for missing accessories).

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible in photos (cracked plastic, bent needle bar, worn feed dogs, rust, odor, overheating).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the needle area, feed dogs, and any visible wear points; plus a photo of the underside/hinges.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with unknown wear (worst-case).

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the model label/plate showing “Brother SE630”.
Video: power on + stitch test (straight stitch) and a short embroidery test stitch-out.
Photos of all included accessories (foot pedal, power cable, bobbins, needles, embroidery hoop/frame, manual/USB if any).
Close-up of needle area/feed dogs and any visible wear/defects.
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a Brother computerized sewing/embroidery-style machine, but the SE630 model number and working condition/accessories cannot be verified remotely from these images. To price confidently (especially for Lagos pickup demand), we need the model label and a quick stitch/embroidery proof.
